review.checkpoint_resume_assessment: Correct. completed_units.jsonl stores unit_id, receipt_path, and receipt_sha256. On resume, verify_completed re-hashes each receipt and the runner executes only missing units. The corruption-detection simulation confirms SHA drift is caught. The fresh root and reuse_v3_failed_root=false are respected.
review.downstream_truncation_assessment: Adequate. The first-party _render_transcript applies _truncate per message with transcript_max_chars. The wrapper asserts len(f'[user] {evidence_text}') <= transcript_max_chars before insertion, and the runner checks the same. Freezing transcript_max_chars >= 100000 with historical evidence blocks at 3134-9340 chars makes truncation nonbinding. No later truncation in the summary/patch path was found that would invalidate parity: _summarize_one and _propose_patch operate on the already-rendered transcript and summaries without additional length-based truncation of the evidence itself.
review.exact_retokenized_parity_assessment: Correct. ExactMatchedEvidenceBlockRenderer searches deterministic source-token budgets and accepts only pairs whose final rendered UTF-8 blocks re-encode to exactly equal token counts under the frozen tiktoken 0.11.0/cl100k_base tokenizer. This directly addresses the V3 BPE splice bug. The no-padding deterministic search over progressively wider windows, selecting the largest common reachable final length, is acceptable and arm-order-independent.
review.mechanical_pilot_scope_assessment: Respected. The draft contract and runner use only the 12 frozen historical E0 pools, zero provider calls, zero new actor rollouts, no held-out future-skill evaluation, immediate content-addressed checkpointing, SHA-validated missing-unit resume, and a fresh run root distinct from the failed V3 root. The runner enforces EXPECTED_STATUS and authority flags, revalidates all bound SHAs, and forbids scientific effectiveness evaluation.
nonblocking_notes: The mechanical runner's FORBIDDEN_VISIBLE_MARKERS check is a heuristic string scan; the authoritative blinding guarantee rests on the pinned first-party source audit and the BlindedEvidenceUnit construction, which are sound.
The historical replay's 12/12 parity is engineering evidence only and correctly carries no scientific-effect authority.
The WIN-A/WIN-B negative-control equivalence must be evaluated before MRW interpretation; the design already orders this correctly.

review.stream_level_theory_assessment: Correct.
